answer_1.quote: For a broad variety of tasks, such as argument mining, argument retrieval, argumentation generation, and question answering, compiling labeled data for argument quality remains an important prerequisite, yet, also a difficult problem.

answer_4.quote: Using Amazon's Mechanical Turk, in a first preprocessing step, we tasked crowd workers with deciding whether or not a given retrieved item actually contained argumentative text.
answer_4.guideline: Which text has the better logical structure? (logical quality), Which text has the better style of speech? (rhetorical quality), and Which text would be more useful in a debate? (dialectical quality).
